raw_text: Copilot suggestions have a noticeable 3-4 second delay on my home internet. Same code completes instantly at the office. This is blocking my workflow.
Extension host keeps crashing with Data Loss Studio extension. Losing unsaved work every day. This is a critical issue.
Git integration doesn't properly detect changes in files. Sometimes I need to reload the window for changes to show up. Very disruptive.
Settings sync not working every time. Have to manually reconfigure Copilot settings on every machine. Time consuming.
It would be great to have a dark mode toggle button in the UI instead of going through settings every time.
The debugger keeps disconnecting from remote processes. Every time this happens, I lose my debugging session and have to restart.
Would really appreciate better file preview functionality when hovering over tabs. Just a quick preview would help navigating large projects.
Terminal doesn't properly handle long running processes with colored output. Colors get garbled every time.
